verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no way to sync a Figma Make app to a local environment, edit it in your own editor, and push changes back. What it does document is adjacent: in-platform code editing (figma-make-docs-7) and the note that generated code is included in the Make project (figma-make-docs-33). Community evidence adds that Figma's API returns 400 for .make files, so users had to reverse-engineer the format just to extract code, with nothing pushed back (figma-make-comm-1).

support.subject: As a developer, I can work on the app locally with my own editor and tooling and push changes back to the platform
